title: PIXL 8000 Rainbow Rush Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Rainbow Rush is a lively vape with a mix of fruit-flavoured confectionery and tangy sherbet. It’s bright, sweet, and slightly fizzy — perfect for fans of fun, nostalgic flavours. This pod includes 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 10ml refill reservoir for up to 8000 puffs with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. Mesh coil technology ensures each puff is full of consistent, smooth flavour. With simple draw activation and Boost Mode available, Rainbow Rush is a colourful addition to your MTL routine. One of the more unique flavours in the PIXL 8000 collection.
